d: Bihar men mausam ka mijaj agle kuchh dinon tak badalta huaa najar aaega. rajy ke kaee hisson men tapman men utar-charhav ke sath subah ke samay kohre ka asar dekhne ko mil sakta hai. bharat mausam vigyan vibhag, patna ki or se 21 navanbar ko jari mausam purvanuman ke mutabik, 22 navanbar ko bihar ke dakshin-pashchim, dakshin-madhy aur dakshin-purvi hisson men halke se madhyam star ka kohra chhae rahne ki sanbhavna hai. vahin, rajy ke kuchh jilon men barish ko lekar bhi purvanuman jari kiya gaya hai. halanki, iske bad agle kaee dinon tak rajy ke adhikansh hisson men mausam shushk rahne ki…
